availability: Production server is not configured. Offline racing is available.
release_notes: Free Touch is the mobile default: hold unused left/right screen regions to steer. Finger ownership, center dead zone, pedal priority and animated wheel feedback support simultaneous gas, steering and drift.

Controls preserve manual/automatic gas, separate 0–100% steering sensitivity, smooth centering, direct wheel, buttons, joystick and tilt. Existing saved progress and explicit direct-wheel preferences are preserved.
Multiplayer separates transport connection from server sign-in, disables unavailable room actions, bounds retries, handles connection loss safely and explains Android localhost/LAN addresses.
Two ready human racers can start an eight-slot lobby. Human slots take precedence over AI, all drivers share a loading barrier and countdown, and room admission failures have actionable messages.
Native room invitations copy the real room code. Players choose the same Production, Development or Custom server; the download website does not host live racing.

A dedicated server image includes the original shared physics and collision geometry without client textures or car models. Configurable room/car limits, health metrics, supervisor recovery and a free Render blueprint are included.
Regression, Free Touch, two-client complete-race, gateway, room isolation, reconnect and hostile-input tests run locally and in GitHub Actions. Public hosting is not yet provisioned.
Original native Android/Windows graphics, models, track, 120 Hz client physics, prior mobile renderer repairs and signed data-only updates are retained.

Development preview: final APK phone performance/rendering/touch and physical Android–Windows/public-internet multiplayer remain unverified. A connected hosting account is required for cloud deployment.
limitations: Physical Android installation testing remains incomplete.
